ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity-to-low intensity ratio (approximately 85:15) with a dominant high-intensity white central field and low-intensity black margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white/light-gray field across >80% of the visible fluke surface. A distinct low-intensity black perimeter band (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) follows the trailing and lateral edges. Sparse, low-intensity focal spots (dark gray/black) are distributed non-uniformly across the central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 105 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth approximately 6% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-level jaggedness and material loss (peaks and valleys) concentrated at the terminal distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, indicating a wide, swept-back wing geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 8-12 localized, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (dark spots) corresponding to rosette-style scarring, primarily clustered in the lower-central region and mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, low-intensity diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the right lobe, intersecting the otherwise uniform high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular chipping and loss of material observed at the far lateral margins (tips) of both the left and right lobes.
